description: Full bpRNA-1m (26,063-sequence) matched-condition runtime/memory comparison between LinearRaccess and Raccess Window, replacing the K=4-vs-K=1, unequal-timing-boundary production data in benchmark/results/bprna_runs, benchmark/results/bprna_memory_runs, and benchmark/results/raccess_w100. Both tools use the same access_len list (1,3,7,10) and are timed identically via /usr/bin/time -v around the executable alone, strictly sequentially (no thread pool). Supersedes benchmark/results/matched_runtime_comparison_20260919 (a 408-sequence subsample of this same check) as the source for Fig. 3 and Results S3.3.
